## Scope Check
- [ ] This proposal respects CareFund's non-clinical funding boundary (no raw PHI/PII, commitments only).
- [ ] This proposal does not violate on-chain authorization models or custodial safety.

## Proposed Improvement
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you propose.

## Motivation / Problem Statement
What problem does this solve? Why is this valuable for sponsors, providers, or attesters?

## Proposed Technical Approach
Outline how this would fit into the contracts, Go API, TypeScript SDK, or Next.js web application.

## Potential Impact and Trade-offs
Consider contract storage limits, gas costs, database schema migrations, and security implications.
